# Tasks Document

- [ ] 1. Model fields and geometry
  - Files: presstoshape/models/shapes.py, presstoshape/geometry/segments.py, presstoshape/geometry/transforms.py, presstoshape/geometry/booleans.py, tests/geometry/*
  - `Style` gains opacity, fill_opacity, stroke_opacity, fill_rule, cap, join, miter_limit, dashes, dash_offset (+ `Literal` types); `RectShape.rx/ry`, `TextShape.anchor` appended after `transform`; a shared `sanitize_style_changes` helper (clamp opacities, enum check, even-length non-negative dashes) in models or geometry; rounded `rect_segments` with clamping; `transform_shape(..., scale_radii=False)`; `booleans.simplify(segments, evenodd)` and `transforms.area_outline`; Composite part outlines use `area_outline`
  - Purpose: data and pure math for every later task (Req 1, 2, 3, 4, 7)
  - _Leverage: ellipse_segments kappa, transform_shape canonical form, booleans.combine_parts_
  - _Requirements: 1.1, 1.5, 2.1, 3.1, 4.1, 4.5, 4.6, 7.3_
  - _Prompt: Implement the task for spec svg-import-fidelity, first run spec-workflow-guide to get the workflow guide then implement the task: Role: Python developer experienced in computational geometry | Task: Implement Components 1 and 2 of design.md; tests: zero radii give today's rect segments exactly, radii clamped, rect resize keeps radii, scale_radii scales them, skew branch untouched, area_outline of an evenodd ring (two same-direction contours) is a ring, nonzero shapes unchanged, Composite with an evenodd part, sanitizer cases | Restrictions: defaults must reproduce today's behaviour; no Qt; speaking names | Success: full suite green (existing tests unchanged). Before starting set this task to [-] in tasks.md; after finishing log it with log-implementation (with artifacts) and set it to [x]._

- [ ] 2. Rendering, hit-testing and bounds
  - Files: presstoshape/render/paths.py, presstoshape/render/scene.py, presstoshape/render/text.py, presstoshape/render/hit_test.py, presstoshape/render/export.py (if needed), tests/render/*
  - Fill type from style; `stroke_paint(style, width=None)` with cap/join/miter/dash; overlay paints no longer use `stroke_paint`; paint alphas from opacities; `saveLayerAlpha` only for opacity < 1 with fill and stroke; opacity 0 skips drawing; `drawRRect` for rounded rects; `anchor_offset` used by blob drawing and `text_path`; square-cap bounds
  - Purpose: canvas, export and picking show the new style (Req 1.2, 2.2, 2.3, 2.9, 3.2, 4.1, 7.3)
  - _Leverage: PathCache, _paints, text._font, CPU raster surface tests_
  - _Requirements: 1.2, 2.2, 2.3, 2.9, 3.2, 4.1, 7.3_
  - _Prompt: Implement the task for spec svg-import-fidelity, first run spec-workflow-guide to get the workflow guide then implement the task: Role: Python developer experienced with Skia | Task: Implement Component 3 of design.md; CPU pixel tests: evenodd hole empty, opacity layer makes fill/stroke overlap not darker, fill/stroke opacity alpha, dash gap pixel empty, round cap pixel beyond end point, rounded corner pixel empty, middle/end anchor shift; hit tests: evenodd hole misses, dash gap misses at zero tolerance, 0 % opacity shape still hit | Restrictions: no extra layer or extra per-shape work for default styles; run scripts/bench_canvas.py before and after (CPU and GL) and report numbers | Success: tests green, benchmark unchanged within noise. Before starting set this task to [-] in tasks.md; after finishing log it with log-implementation (with artifacts) and set it to [x]._

- [ ] 3. Native format v4 and SVG writer
  - Files: presstoshape/formats/p2s.py, presstoshape/formats/p2s_migrations.py, tests/formats/samples/v3.p2s, docs/file-format.md, presstoshape/formats/svg.py (writer part), tests/formats/*
  - Encode/decode new style, rect and text fields (optional, validated, defaults); `CURRENT_VERSION = 4` with identity migration; v3 sample; doc row; SVG writer emits non-default fields as presentation attributes
  - Purpose: everything new is saved and reopened (Req 1.3, 2.6, 3.4, 4.3, 7.4, 9)
  - _Leverage: encode_style/decode_style, existing p2s round-trip and sample tests, _untransformed_element_
  - _Requirements: 1.3, 2.6, 3.4, 4.3, 7.4, 9.1–9.4_
  - _Prompt: Implement the task for spec svg-import-fidelity, first run spec-workflow-guide to get the workflow guide then implement the task: Role: Python developer | Task: Implement Component 6 and the writer part of Component 5 of design.md; tests: p2s round trip of every field (shapes, Composite parts, tool styles), v3 sample opens with defaults, damaged values refused with field path, SVG written for default styles is byte-identical to today, every non-default field written and read back by the current reader where it already can (rest covered in task 5) | Restrictions: follow the native format rules in CLAUDE.md; encoders explicit per field | Success: tests green. Before starting set this task to [-] in tasks.md; after finishing log it with log-implementation (with artifacts) and set it to [x]._

- [ ] 4. CSS module
  - Files: presstoshape/formats/css.py, tests/formats/test_css.py
  - `Compound`, `Rule`, `Stylesheet.declarations_for`, `parse`: comments, at-rules (block and statement), selector lists, compound selectors, unsupported selectors counted in `skipped`, `!important`, declaration splitting outside parentheses/quotes, indexed lookup
  - Purpose: Illustrator-style class styling (Req 5)
  - _Leverage: none (stdlib only)_
  - _Requirements: 5.1, 5.2, 5.4, 5.5, 5.6_
  - _Prompt: Implement the task for spec svg-import-fidelity, first run spec-workflow-guide to get the workflow guide then implement the task: Role: Python developer experienced in parsers | Task: Implement Component 4 of design.md with tests for each listed case plus specificity (id > class > tag), equal specificity → later wins, important beats normal, malformed input recovers at the next rule, 500 rules × 10,000 lookups fast (< 0.5 s) | Restrictions: no Qt, no new dependency, formats layer imports only models/geometry/stdlib | Success: tests and architecture test green. Before starting set this task to [-] in tasks.md; after finishing log it with log-implementation (with artifacts) and set it to [x]._

- [ ] 5. SVG reader: cascade, styles, use/symbol, text runs, notes
  - Files: presstoshape/formats/svg.py, presstoshape/formats/svg_notes.py, tests/formats/test_svg*.py, tests/formats/samples/svg/{illustrator_classes,inkscape_layers_text,figma_frame,icon_sprite}.svg
  - New cascade with stylesheet; extended `_STYLE_KEYS`; non-inherited opacity with group multiplier; visibility; colour alpha; stroke options parsing and scaling; rect rx/ry (with `scale_radii=True`); id index, `<use>`/`<symbol>` expansion with cycle/depth guard; skipped containers; tspan runs with em units and anchor; `NoteCollector` with counted `ngettext` messages (Composite notes moved into it)
  - Purpose: foreign SVGs open correctly or report what's missing (Req 1.3, 2.4, 2.5, 3.3, 4.2, 5, 6, 7.1, 7.2, 7.4, 7.6, 8.1, 8.4, 10)
  - _Leverage: _Reader, _merge_style, _color, _length, _parse_transform, formats/css.py, existing SVG tests_
  - _Requirements: 1.3, 2.4, 2.5, 3.3, 4.2, 5.1–5.7, 6.1–6.6, 7.1, 7.2, 7.4, 7.6, 8.1, 8.4, 10.1, 10.2_
  - _Prompt: Implement the task for spec svg-import-fidelity, first run spec-workflow-guide to get the workflow guide then implement the task: Role: Python developer experienced with SVG | Task: Implement Component 5 (reader + notes) of design.md; write the four hand-made fixtures and tests per the design's testing strategy (each property via attribute/inline/CSS/inheritance, precedence order, alpha, group opacity note, use x/y/transform, forward refs, symbol viewBox, missing and cyclic refs, tspan x/y/dy/em, mixed-style note, rect radii under scale, notes for clip/mask/image/filter/marker/nested svg/unknown, none for Inkscape/PressToShape metadata); time a 10,000-shape SVG before/after (< 2×) | Restrictions: svgelements only for path data, colours, lengths, transforms; fixtures hand-written, not copied from third-party files; never crash on foreign input | Success: tests green, PressToShape's own SVG output still round-trips unchanged. Before starting set this task to [-] in tasks.md; after finishing log it with log-implementation (with artifacts) and set it to [x]._

- [ ] 6. Operations
  - Files: presstoshape/editing/operations/style.py, presstoshape/editing/operations/shapes.py, presstoshape/editing/operations/view.py, presstoshape/editing/operations/documents.py, presstoshape/models/app_state.py, tests/editing/*
  - `style.set_style(session, **changes)` with label table and merge keys, sanitized; `view.set_tool_style` uses the same sanitizer; `shapes.set_corner_radius`, `shapes.set_text_anchor` (anchor point stays); `AppState.import_notes`, set by `open_file` (short status message), `view.clear_import_notes`
  - Purpose: every new property is editable and undoable; open passes notes to the window (Req 1.4, 2.7, 2.8, 3.6, 4.4, 7.5, 8.2, 9.5)
  - _Leverage: style._restyle, map_selected, session.edit merge_key_
  - _Requirements: 1.4, 2.7, 2.8, 3.6, 4.4, 7.5, 8.2, 9.5_
  - _Prompt: Implement the task for spec svg-import-fidelity, first run spec-workflow-guide to get the workflow guide then implement the task: Role: Python developer | Task: Implement Component 7 of design.md; tests: each field one undo step with its label, slider-like repeated opacity changes merge, invalid values sanitized, radius only affects rects, anchor change keeps (x, y), undo restores, open of a lossy SVG fills import_notes and a clean SVG/.p2s leaves it empty, import_notes not in undo or the document | Restrictions: operations take plain values; views untouched in this task | Success: tests green. Before starting set this task to [-] in tasks.md; after finishing log it with log-implementation (with artifacts) and set it to [x]._

- [ ] 7. Style editor, selection panel and tool options
  - Files: presstoshape/views/style_editor.py, presstoshape/views/selection_view.py, presstoshape/views/tool_options_view.py, presstoshape/icons.py, scripts/generate_icons.py, presstoshape/assets/icons/*.svg, tests/views/*
  - `StyleEditor` field groups and single `on_change(dict)` callback; fill/stroke opacity next to swatches, object opacity slider + spin, fill rule combo, cap/join icon groups, miter limit, dash field + offset (document unit), mixed values; selection panel corner radius and anchor rows; tool options with new groups; new Tabler icons generated
  - Purpose: users can see and change the new properties (Req 1.4, 2.7, 2.8, 3.5, 4.4, 7.5)
  - _Leverage: _PaintRow, LengthSpinBox, icon_engine.icon, generate_icons.py, existing view tests_
  - _Requirements: 1.4, 2.7, 2.8, 3.5, 4.4, 7.5, NFR Usability_
  - _Prompt: Implement the task for spec svg-import-fidelity, first run spec-workflow-guide to get the workflow guide then implement the task: Role: Python/PySide6 developer | Task: Implement Component 8 (except the dialog) of design.md; view tests: refresh never emits, rows shown/hidden per shape type and paint on/off, mixed selection shows indeterminate, editing calls the right operation; screenshots (scripts/screenshot_app.py) of the panel with rect, text and dashed path selected, en and de, cropped and checked for crowding | Restrictions: views never assign AppState; blockSignals while writing values; lambda wrappers for checked-signals; no new shortcuts; all text via i18n | Success: tests green, panel looks tidy in both languages. Before starting set this task to [-] in tasks.md; after finishing log it with log-implementation (with artifacts) and set it to [x]._

- [ ] 8. Import report dialog
  - Files: presstoshape/views/import_report_dialog.py, presstoshape/views/main_window.py, tests/views/*
  - Dialog listing notes with the save hint; `MainWindow.open_path` shows it when `import_notes` is non-empty, then clears them; paste unchanged (status bar)
  - Purpose: no silent losses (Req 8.2, 8.3)
  - _Leverage: existing dialogs (export_dialog, recovery dialog) for style; open_path_
  - _Requirements: 8.2, 8.3_
  - _Prompt: Implement the task for spec svg-import-fidelity, first run spec-workflow-guide to get the workflow guide then implement the task: Role: Python/PySide6 developer | Task: Implement the ImportReportDialog part of Component 8; test that open_path with a lossy fixture shows it (patch exec) and a clean file doesn't; QTest scratch run opening each fixture offscreen and with GL, screenshot the dialog | Restrictions: dialog gets plain strings, no state access; parent it to the window | Success: tests green, dialog verified on both renderers. Before starting set this task to [-] in tasks.md; after finishing log it with log-implementation (with artifacts) and set it to [x]._

- [ ] 9. Translations, docs and final check
  - Files: presstoshape/assets/translations/*, README.md, FAQ.md, .spec-workflow/steering/product.md, .spec-workflow/steering/structure.md, FEATURE_GAPS.md (local)
  - Update template, German complete; README/FAQ import and styling notes (hedged); product.md current features; structure.md (css.py, svg_notes.py, dialog); FEATURE_GAPS ticks (opacity, stroke options, rounded corners, partial SVG import); full suite, self-test, bench, screenshots en/de; manual Inkscape round trip check list for the user
  - Purpose: complete, documented feature
  - _Requirements: all_
  - _Prompt: Implement the task for spec svg-import-fidelity, first run spec-workflow-guide to get the workflow guide then implement the task: Role: Developer focused on docs | Task: Translate, update docs, run all checks; tell the user what to try by hand (own SVGs from Illustrator/Inkscape/Figma, Inkscape round trip) | Restrictions: British English, hedged public wording, no em dashes in user-facing prose; FEATURE_GAPS.md stays uncommitted | Success: suite green, docs match behaviour.
